x: Albert Boddy has been called up and is with the General Service Corps in Cornwall. Len Spooner has gained another pip and is now a Captain.
Adie is with the Royal Engineers at Aldershot. Albert Boddy has finished his initial training and has been moved up to Derby. Bill Jones hopes to be de-mobbed in June.
